# END FILE TYPE

End a FILE TYPE definition and read the file.

## Syntax

```text
END FILE TYPE.
```

## Example

```text
FILE TYPE MIXED RECORD=rectype 1-2.
RECORD TYPE 13.
DATA LIST /team 4 minutes 7-9.
END FILE TYPE.
```

`statscraft help END FILE TYPE` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
